notes: The main record merges Chenguang (Hebei natural-extracts maker, ticker XSHE:300138, LEI 655600XIK27S3214IO50) with aliases for Beijing Tsingke Biotech / Tsingke Biotechnology, which is a different company (gene synthesis). Because of this merge, the two BIS Entity List designations dated 2025-09-12 may belong to Tsingke rather than Chenguang. Inferred, not verified; check the BIS Federal Register entry before showing BIS as a Chenguang finding. The UFLPA (2023-08-02) and Uyghur-region research designations fit Chenguang's Xinjiang operations.

tia_quick_check reports the entity as 'not_screened': designations are platform-attached annotations, not a screening result. Entity badges show US BIS x2, Forced Labor Research x2, UFLPA x1, but quick_check listed only one Forced Labor Research designation.

Only one subsidiary is linked: Chenguang Biotechnology Group Yanqi Co., Ltd. (Xinjiang), which has its own UFLPA badge. The Shache subsidiary exists as three unlinked, unannotated shipping-record duplicates. No Hotan record was found.
Searching 'Xinjiang Chenguang' returned only unrelated companies sharing the Chenguang name (construction, tomato, carbon, etc.); none were treated as related.

Trade: 7 suppliers (all listed; includes the group's own India unit Chenguang Natural Extracts India, twice as duplicate records) and 75 buyers in total, of which the first 25 are stored. Trade relationships carry no country field, so supplier/buyer country is null; badges were not looked up.

Notable buyers include International Flavors & Fragrances (Mexico) (two records, very broad flavour/chemical HS range) and ROHA (Vietnam and Mexico); products are mostly plant extracts, oleoresins and colourants (HS 1302, 3301, 3203).

Flagged paths: direction 'in' returned none. Direction 'out' returned 7 paths; 6 were dropped (only Natl Security badges). The one kept path ends at an entity literally named 'Canada' with US OFAC badges via buyer Plant Lipids, which looks like a data artifact (a country parsed as a company) rather than a real sanctioned counterparty.
Tier-1 buyers in the paths (Plant Lipids, Umalaxmi Organics, Sri Krishna Enterprises, Universal Oleoresins) are among the 50 buyers not stored on page 1.
